name: TLY Pay for WooCommerce
author: TLY Pay

sections.description:
TLY Pay for WooCommerce is a crypto payment gateway for WooCommerce. Customers pay with stablecoins
or coins at checkout, and each payment goes straight to your own wallet. TLY Pay is non-custodial: it
does not hold your funds.

The plugin connects a store to a TLY Pay account. The customer pays in the TLY Pay window on the
checkout page, or on the hosted TLY Pay page. Signed payment notifications update the WooCommerce
order.

Accepted coins and networks

  • Ethereum (ERC-20): ETH, USDT, USDC, DAI
  • TRON (TRC-20): TRX, USDT
  • BSC (BEP-20): BNB, USDT, USDC, DAI
  • Polygon: POL, USDT, USDC, DAI
  • Base: ETH, USDC, DAI
  • Arbitrum One: ETH, USDT0, USDC, DAI
  • Optimism: ETH, USDT, USDC, DAI
  • Bitcoin: BTC

Checkout shows the coins and networks your store wallet accepts.

Features

  • Connect by signing in to TLY Pay. No credentials are copied by hand.
  • The checkout method lists the crypto assets the store wallet accepts.
  • An order is marked paid only after TLY Pay confirms it.
  • WooCommerce > TLY Pay lists those orders and can reconcile one with TLY Pay.
  • Traditional checkout, Checkout Blocks and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) are supported.

A TLY Pay account is required.

Screenshots, requirements and the accepted coins are on the plugin page:
Crypto payments for WooCommerce.

External services

The plugin does not work without the TLY Pay service (https://tlypay.com/). The production package
uses the hostnames below.

Terms of service: https://tlypay.com/terms/
Privacy policy: https://tlypay.com/privacy/

Merchant API (https://api.tlypay.com/)

The WordPress server calls this API with the key received when the store connects. It reads the
store profile and registers this site’s notification URL, creates a Payment at checkout, and reads
or cancels that Payment when a notification arrives, an unpaid order is cancelled, or an
administrator reconciles it.

Sent: order number, amount, currency, this site’s installation reference, the site URL and the
order-received URL. No customer name, email or address is sent.

Connection check

After the store connects, TLY Pay sends one signed check to this site’s notification URL, and the
plugin answers it.

Sent in the signed answer: the plugin version, the WooCommerce version and whether the TLY Pay
payment method is enabled in the store.

TLY Pay app (https://app.tlypay.com/)

An administrator opens the app to sign in and approve the connection. Customers do not use the app.

Checkout (https://pay.tlypay.com/)

The customer’s browser loads the payment window from pay.tlypay.com, or opens the hosted payment
page. The Payment ID is passed to TLY Pay. Anything the customer enters there is entered on TLY Pay.

Privacy

Payment records, notifications and the installation reference stay in the WordPress database after
deactivation or deletion. During payment the customer’s browser contacts pay.tlypay.com, so TLY Pay
receives that visit’s IP address and browser details.
sections.installation:
1. Install from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the ZIP under Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce 9.0 or newer must be active.
  3. Click Connect TLY Pay, sign in and approve the store.
  4. Use HTTPS and a permalink structure other than Plain.

Each website uses the same TLY Pay account and that account’s currency, and keeps its own
notification URL. On a copied site, delete the tlypay_wc_client_ref option before connecting.
sections.faq:
Which coins and networks can customers pay with?

USDT, USDC and DAI stablecoins, and BTC, ETH, BNB, TRX and POL, on Ethereum, TRON, BSC, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum One, Optimism and Bitcoin. The Description lists the coins of each network.

Does TLY Pay hold my funds?

No. TLY Pay is non-custodial. Customers pay to addresses of your own wallet.

Which wallets can customers use?

On Ethereum, TRON, BSC, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum One and Optimism, customers pay from a wallet such as MetaMask, TronLink or a WalletConnect wallet. Bitcoin payments are sent to the address or QR code shown at checkout.

Which store currency can I use?

The WooCommerce currency must match the TLY Pay account. Until it does, TLY Pay stays hidden at checkout. Orders that already have a TLY Pay payment can still be paid from the order’s payment page.

How do refunds work?

The plugin does not refund a payment. Refund from the TLY Pay account or with the customer, then record a manual refund on the order if needed.

Which PHP version do I need?

PHP 8.3 or later. Keep PHP on a release that includes the security fixes of October 2026: 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12 or later, or a patched build from your host or operating system.

Where do updates come from?

The WordPress plugin directory. The plugin does not check TLY Pay for new versions.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • The plugin homepage link points to the TLY Pay for WooCommerce page on tlypay.com. No functional changes.

1.0.1

  • Customers can pay an order that already has a TLY Pay payment after your store currency changes.
  • When TLY Pay rejects a payment after a currency change, the connection is checked again within minutes, so checkout stops offering TLY Pay sooner.
  • The currency notice no longer asks you to reconnect: TLY Pay returns to checkout once the currencies match.
  • Choose the coin icons shown next to the payment method title at checkout in WooCommerce > TLY Pay > Settings > Checkout appearance. Every supported coin is listed, a note names the coins you select that your TLY Pay store does not accept yet, and USDT and USDT0 share one Tether icon.
  • Until you choose, checkout shows the icons of every coin your store accepts, without a count of the rest. Sync with TLY Pay store selects the coins your store accepts now.
  • Change the payment method title (default: Crypto payment, up to 40 characters) under Customize text.
  • The text under the title is now optional and off by default. Turn on Show coin names under the title to show it; it names the same coins as the icons.
  • A live preview shows the payment method in your theme’s checkout styling before you save.
  • Connecting TLY Pay no longer warns that the TLY Pay window was closed while you are still signing in.
  • With the block checkout, closing the payment window without paying now explains how to continue instead of showing a generic error.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
